corpus.legitimate_source: Tranco top-15k domains as bare http://host/ (popularity proxy)

algorithm: sklearn LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000) on StandardScaler lexical features
limitations: Weak supervision: popularity is a proxy for legitimacy, not proof; URLhaus rows are payload droppers with heavy paths while legitimate rows are bare domains, so the model partly separates URL shape, not just maliciousness.
UCI phishing research corpus was NOT used for training (no URL strings); it remains the offline research benchmark.
No timestamps on legitimate rows: no time-split evaluation possible; scores are uncalibrated.
Never trained on Cyber-Sakhi case data (governance restriction).
Status: experimental. Not production-validated. All outputs are suggestions requiring analyst review.

Out-of-distribution probe 2026-09-25: only 86/185 (46.5%) reporter-tagged TweetFeed phishing URLs score >= 0.5. Test-set 99.9%% accuracy does NOT transfer to phishing detection; the model separates dropper-URL shape from bare popular domains. The deterministic rule baseline remains the enforced enrichment; statistical scores are shown with this caveat and require analyst review.
